programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Tedenska predstavitev vsebin iz lokalnega okolja. Voditeljica Špela Pokeržnik gosti športnike, glasbenike, politike in vodje društev. Delati dlje, a kako? Vlada želi, da bi ljudje delali dlje, toda glede tega, kako naj bi to uspelo, si ÖVP, SPÖ in NEOS niso enotni. Medtem ko NEOS vztraja pri zvišanju upokojitvene starosti in uvedbi delne delovne zmožnosti, si SPÖ želi sistem bonusov in malusov za podjetja, da bi ta zaposlovala in zadržala več starejših delavcev. Že zdaj namreč obstaja veliko panog, v katerih se niti polovica zaposlenih ne upokoji neposredno iz delovnega razmerja. Toda kaj je resnično potrebno, kateri predlogi so smiselni? Patrick Gruska, Lena Hager in Ulla Kramar-Schmid so se pogovarjali s prizadetimi, strokovnjaki in politiki. V živo v studiu bo gostja: predsednica Delavske zbornice Renate Anderl. Vajeništvo v krizi: Zakaj je uspešen model pod pritiskom: Avstrija je bila desetletja ponosna na uspešen model vajeništva. Medtem pa se ta sooča z velikimi težavami. Na vzhodu primanjkuje vajeniških mest, na zahodu pa vajencev. Primer za to je zvezna dežela Salzburg. Tam je po podatkih AMS oktobra na voljo 121 prostih vajeniških mest za kuharice in kuhinjske pomočnike, a le deset iskalcev. V zvezni prestolnici pa mnogi iskalci v boju za prosta vajeniška mesta ostanejo praznih rok. Lena Hager, Alexandra Nöbauer in Marlene Seidel v Salzburgu in na Dunaju preverjajo, zakaj je model vajeništva pod pritiskom in kako lahko uspe sprememba smeri. Bo Avstrija postala zgolj opazovalka umetne inteligence? Naslednji avstrijski veliki podatkovni center naj bi nastal na Gradiščanskem. Šele pred nekaj meseci je podoben načrt v zgornjeavstrijskem Kronstorfu povzročil veliko kritik. Prebivalstvo je zaman protestiralo proti Googlovemu velikemu podatkovnemu centru, ki porablja domače vire, ne da bi ustvarjal lokalno dodano vrednost. Pod geslom "Nickelsdorf ne sme postati Kronstorf" Energie Burgenland predstavlja nov projekt z zaprtim hladilnim krogom in okolju prijaznimi baterijami namesto dizelskih agregatov. Laura Franz in Sabina Riedl preverjata utrip v Nickelsdorfu – kakšno je razpoloženje v lokalni politiki in med prebivalstvom? Ali mora Avstrija res vedno ostati zgolj stranska opazovalka ameriških tehnoloških velikanov? Avstrijski strokovnjak na Harvardu in raziskovalec umetne inteligence Raphael Suchomel meni, da bi Avstrija lahko sedela pri mizi za odrasle, če bi spodbujala svoje talente in vlagala v lastne podatkovne centre. Vlada pripravlja strategijo za velike podatkovne centre, ki jo želi državni sekretar za digitalizacijo Alexander Pröll predstaviti 19. novembra.

Vlada želi, da bi ljudje delali dlje, toda glede tega, kako naj bi to uspelo, si ÖVP, SPÖ in NEOS niso enotni. Medtem ko NEOS vztraja pri zvišanju upokojitvene starosti in uvedbi delne delovne zmožnosti, si SPÖ želi sistem bonusov in malusov za podjetja, da bi ta zaposlovala in zadržala več starejših delavcev. Že zdaj namreč obstaja veliko panog, v katerih se niti polovica zaposlenih ne upokoji neposredno iz delovnega razmerja. Toda kaj je resnično potrebno, kateri predlogi so smiselni? Patrick Gruska, Lena Hager in Ulla Kramar-Schmid so se pogovarjali s prizadetimi, strokovnjaki in politiki. V živo v studiu bo gostja: predsednica Delavske zbornice Renate Anderl. Vajeništvo v krizi: Zakaj je uspešen model pod pritiskom: Avstrija je bila desetletja ponosna na uspešen model vajeništva. Medtem pa se ta sooča z velikimi težavami. Na vzhodu primanjkuje vajeniških mest, na zahodu pa vajencev. Primer za to je zvezna dežela Salzburg. Tam je po podatkih AMS oktobra na voljo 121 prostih vajeniških mest za kuharice in kuhinjske pomočnike, a le deset iskalcev. V zvezni prestolnici pa mnogi iskalci v boju za prosta vajeniška mesta ostanejo praznih rok. Lena Hager, Alexandra Nöbauer in Marlene Seidel v Salzburgu in na Dunaju preverjajo, zakaj je model vajeništva pod pritiskom in kako lahko uspe sprememba smeri. Bo Avstrija postala zgolj opazovalka umetne inteligence? Naslednji avstrijski veliki podatkovni center naj bi nastal na Gradiščanskem. Šele pred nekaj meseci je podoben načrt v zgornjeavstrijskem Kronstorfu povzročil veliko kritik. Prebivalstvo je zaman protestiralo proti Googlovemu velikemu podatkovnemu centru, ki porablja domače vire, ne da bi ustvarjal lokalno dodano vrednost. Pod geslom "Nickelsdorf ne sme postati Kronstorf" Energie Burgenland predstavlja nov projekt z zaprtim hladilnim krogom in okolju prijaznimi baterijami namesto dizelskih agregatov. Laura Franz in Sabina Riedl preverjata utrip v Nickelsdorfu – kakšno je razpoloženje v lokalni politiki in med prebivalstvom? Ali mora Avstrija res vedno ostati zgolj stranska opazovalka ameriških tehnoloških velikanov? Avstrijski strokovnjak na Harvardu in raziskovalec umetne inteligence Raphael Suchomel meni, da bi Avstrija lahko sedela pri mizi za odrasle, če bi spodbujala svoje talente in vlagala v lastne podatkovne centre. Vlada pripravlja strategijo za velike podatkovne centre, ki jo želi državni sekretar za digitalizacijo Alexander Pröll predstaviti 19. novembra.

programme.title: 6 Heures de São Paulo | Course
programme.desc: Un mois après les 24 Heures du Mans, remportées par Toyota, avec Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi et Nyck de Vries, qui va s'imposer sur le légendaire circuit d'Interlagos, au Brésil ? L'an dernier, la Cadillac Hertz Team Jota #12 des Britanniques Alex Lynn et Will Stevens et du Français Norman Nato s'était imposée à Sao Paulo.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Paris-Roubaix
programme.desc: 123e édition de Paris-Roubaix, surnommé "l'enfer du Nord", qui inclut 30 secteurs pavés pour une distance totale de 258,3 km. Le vainqueur succédera au palmarès au Néerlandais Mathieu Van der Poel, lauréat des trois dernières éditions. L'édition 2026 proposera un nouvel enchaînement des premières difficultés, ainsi qu'un secteur pavé en montée. Le Slovène Tadej Pogacar n'a pas caché que Paris-Roubaix était l'un de ses principaux objectifs de la saison.

programme.title: Snooker : Open d'Angleterre
programme.desc: La finale de l'Open d'Angleterre oppose l'Anglais Ali Carter au Gallois Mark Williams à Brentwood. Un duel de vétérans du circuit mondial, dont l'âge combiné frôle les 100 ans.

programme.title: Championnats du monde open équipé | 1re session
programme.desc: Les championnats du monde Open équipé de force athlétique 2026 se déroulent à Istanbul. Ils regroupent trois mouvements : le squat, le développé-couché et le soulevé de terre.

programme.title: Ski alpin : Coupe du monde à Crans-Montana
programme.desc: Diffusion de l'étape de Coupe du monde de ski alpin disputée dans une commune suisse du canton du Valais, située dans le district de Sierre. Chaque étape est divisée en trois disciplines : le slalom, le géant et la descente. La première Coupe du monde de ski alpin s'est déroulée en 1967.

programme.title: Vérone | Saut d'obstacles
programme.desc: A suivre une étape de la Coupe du monde de saut d'obstacles, un circuit indoor international d'équitation. Se déroulant tous les ans depuis 1978 sous l'égide de la Fédération équestre internationale, ce circuit est le plus prestigieux de cette discipline. Les meilleurs cavaliers et chevaux passent par des circuits de sélection organisés tout au long de l'année partout dans le monde, et les plus performants se retrouvent pour une finale internationale.

programme.title: The Timeline: The Helmet Catch
programme.desc: The Timeline (Sports). The master storytellers at NFL Films collaborate with VIP celebrities like George Clooney, Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner to chronicle seminal moments in the league's illustrious history. Clooney co-produces the story about how a smuggled audio recording of Super Bowl XIV buoys the spirits of U.S. hostages in Iran in 1980. McGraw co-produces, narrates and contributes music to an episode detailing his close friend Brett Favre's return to Green Bay as a member of the rival Minnesota Vikings. And Renner lends his voice to a two-part film examining the rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, and the impact each franchise has had on its city. Episodes also detail the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the landmark move of the Giants from New York to New Jersey

programme.desc: NCAA. South Carolina vs. ClemsonThe No. 1 South Carolina Gamecocks (2-0) visit the Clemson Tigers (3-0) at Littlejohn Coliseum. South Carolina eyes a third straight victory after an 84-39 rout of North Carolina, while Clemson seeks a fourth after beating UNC Greensboro, 72-44. Guests: South Carolina at Clemson

programme.desc: NCAA. Louisiana College vs. Louisiana-MonroeThe Louisiana-Monroe Warhawks host the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns in Sun Belt play. programme.title: We're #1! 1993 North Carolina Tar Heels
programme.desc: We're #1! 1993 North Carolina Tar Heels (Specials). Players from the 1993 Mens Basketball North Carolina Tar Heels. Reflect on their great season

programme.title: We're #1! – 1991 1992 Duke Blue Devils
programme.desc: We're #1! – 1991 1992 Duke Blue Devils (Sports). Through a mix of archival footage, photographs, game broadcasts and exclusive interviews, We're #1! looks back at the memorable Duke teams that defined an era of college basketball

programme.title: 30 for 30: I Hate Christian Laettner
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Jeux olympiques : Home of the Olympics
programme.desc: Home of the Olympics, ou le magazine de la découverte des Jeux olympiques avec des reportages sur des lieux marquants et des évènements historiques liés à cette compétition, et également au travers d'intimes portraits d'athlètes inoubliables.

programme.title: Ski alpin : Coupe du monde à Crans-Montana
programme.desc: Diffusion de l'étape de Coupe du monde de ski alpin disputée dans une commune suisse du canton du Valais, située dans le district de Sierre. Chaque étape est divisée en trois disciplines : le slalom, le géant et la descente. La première Coupe du monde de ski alpin s'est déroulée en 1967.

programme.title: Ski alpin : Coupe du monde à Crans-Montana
programme.desc: En Suisse, la station de Crans-Montana est réputée depuis longtemps pour ses épreuves de ski alpin, avec notamment la piste du Mont Lachaux.

programme.title: Cyclisme | Retour sur la saison 2026 (F)
programme.desc: Retour sur l'exercice 2026 de cyclisme chez les dames, une année marquée par la domination de Demi Vollering.

programme.title: Cyclisme | Retour sur la saison 2026 (H)
programme.desc: La saison cycliste masculine 2026 touche à sa fin. L'année a été marquée par la domination sans partage de certains leaders, des duels intenses sur les routes de la Vuelta et du Tour, et de grands moments d'émotions sur les Classiques et les Mondiaux. Côté individualités, on retiendra la belle saison de Tadej Pogacar, Remco Evenepoel, Paul Seixas, Wout van Aert ou encore Paul Magnier.

programme.title: Sölden | Slalom Géant (H) - 2e manche
programme.desc: Coup d'envoi de la coupe du monde à Sölden, en Autriche. En slalom géant, le favori était le Suisse Marco Odermatt, tenant du gros globe de cristal et maître de la discipline. Mais il devait compter sur la présence de son compatriote Loïc Meillard et du Brésilien Lucas Pinheiro Braathen. A suivre également le Français Léo Anguenot.

programme.desc: Un mois après les 24 Heures du Mans, remportées par Toyota, avec Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi et Nyck de Vries, qui va s'imposer sur le légendaire circuit d'Interlagos, au Brésil ? L'an dernier, la Cadillac Hertz Team Jota #12 des Britanniques Alex Lynn et Will Stevens et du Français Norman Nato s'était imposée à Sao Paulo.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Paris-Roubaix
programme.desc: 123e édition de Paris-Roubaix, surnommé "l'enfer du Nord", qui inclut 30 secteurs pavés pour une distance totale de 258,3 km. Le vainqueur succédera au palmarès au Néerlandais Mathieu Van der Poel, lauréat des trois dernières éditions. L'édition 2026 proposera un nouvel enchaînement des premières difficultés, ainsi qu'un secteur pavé en montée. Le Slovène Tadej Pogacar n'a pas caché que Paris-Roubaix était l'un de ses principaux objectifs de la saison.

programme.title: Ski alpin : Coupe du monde à Crans-Montana
programme.desc: Diffusion de l'étape de Coupe du monde de ski alpin disputée dans une commune suisse du canton du Valais, située dans le district de Sierre. Chaque étape est divisée en trois disciplines : le slalom, le géant et la descente. La première Coupe du monde de ski alpin s'est déroulée en 1967.

Les meilleurs cavaliers et chevaux passent par des circuits de sélection organisés tout au long de l'année partout dans le monde, et les plus performants se retrouvent pour une finale internationale.

programme.title: The Timeline: The Helmet Catch
programme.desc: The Timeline (Sports). The master storytellers at NFL Films collaborate with VIP celebrities like George Clooney, Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner to chronicle seminal moments in the league's illustrious history. Clooney co-produces the story about how a smuggled audio recording of Super Bowl XIV buoys the spirits of U.S. hostages in Iran in 1980. McGraw co-produces, narrates and contributes music to an episode detailing his close friend Brett Favre's return to Green Bay as a member of the rival Minnesota Vikings. And Renner lends his voice to a two-part film examining the rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, and the impact each franchise has had on its city. Episodes also detail the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the landmark move of the Giants from New York to New Jersey

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: Whoop UCI Mountain Bike World Series
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de la temporada 2026 de la WHOOP UCI Mountain Bike World Series. programme.title: Atlas, la otra pasión
programme.desc: Docu-reality sobre la vida y la historia de un club de fútbol oficial. Se trata de un club muy particular, ATLAS el último de los últimos de la primera división D. El Club Atlético Atlas es quien por haber quedado último en El Campeonato de Primera División D, perdió la afiliación a AFA por un año y durante ese período perdió también a los jugadores, cuerpo técnico, camisetas, pelotas, redes. Absolutamente todo. El desenlace será la consagración o la frustración de este grupo de jóvenes y de dirigentes que todo lo hacen impulsados por la pasión.

programme.title: ONE
programme.desc: Toda la acción y el espectáculo de la franquicia One Champioship, con origen en Singapur. La mayor franquicia de deportes de contacto del mundo, disfruta de los enfrentamientos de MMA, muay thai y kickboxing.

programme.title: Il Lombardia
programme.desc: Disfrute de la carrera que tradicionalmente pone fin a la temporada ciclista más importante. De Bérgamo a Como, la Lombardía reúne a los mejores ciclistas del mundo.

programme.title: CRO Race
programme.desc: Disfruta lo más destacado de las jornadas de competencia en el marco de la Carrera CRO 2026. Siete equipos UCI WorldTeams , diez UCI ProTeams y dos equipos UCI Continental conformaron los 19 equipos que participan en la prueba. Los amantes del deporte podrán disfrutar de una competición que consta de 6 etapas que conectan el interior del territorio con la costa croata.

programme.title: 30 for 30: I Hate Christian Laettner
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Detroit vs. Los Angeles. WTGL
programme.desc: Disfrute de la versión femenina de la liga, creada en colaboración directa con la LPGA. Mantiene exactamente el mismo formato de entretenimiento tecnológico de corta duración, el uso de micrófonos abiertos en las jugadoras y análisis estadísticos en tiempo real. Su objetivo es conectar con nuevas audiencias y dar una plataforma masiva y moderna a las estrellas del golf femenino mundial. Gaby López es la representante de México en la temporada inaugural de la WTGL, fue confirmada oficialmente como parte del equipo Los Angeles Golf Club (LAGC).

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: College Football: Florida State at Pittsburgh (Acrisure Stadium, Pittsburgh, PA, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Florida State vs. PittsburghThe Pittsburgh Panthers meet the Florida State Seminoles. Pittsburgh (6-3) looks to build on on five sacks in a 34-11 win over Georgia Tech, while 4-5 Florida State is bolstered by two key interceptions in a 31-24 victory over Boston College. Guests: Florida State at Pittsburgh

programme.desc: College GameDay (Sports). Originating from the site of one of the day's best matchups, with a sea of fans cheering wildly in the background, host Rece Davis and analysts Lee Corso, Kirk Herbstreit and Desmond Howard talk college football for three hours, reporting on the top teams, games, players and storylines. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Atlas, la otra pasión
programme.desc: Docu-reality sobre la vida y la historia de un club de fútbol oficial. Se trata de un club muy particular, ATLAS el último de los últimos de la primera división D. El Club Atlético Atlas es quien por haber quedado último en El Campeonato de Primera División D, perdió la afiliación a AFA por un año y durante ese período perdió también a los jugadores, cuerpo técnico, camisetas, pelotas, redes. Absolutamente todo. El desenlace será la consagración o la frustración de este grupo de jóvenes y de dirigentes que todo lo hacen impulsados por la pasión.
